runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.pollErrorsTitle: Some repositories could not be polled

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.noRepos: This workspace has no imported repositories, so there is nothing to add a workflow to. Import one first.
exportWizard.alreadyInstalled: {repo} already runs this agent in CI. Installing adds a commit to the existing devdigest/ci pull request and updates that installation — it does not open a second one.
exportWizard.noTriggerReason: Select at least one trigger to continue.
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: To block merges: set Fail CI on (CI tab) so the run exits non-zero, then add a required status check in the repo’s GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App needed.
exportWizard.regenBody: You edited {path} by hand. Changing this setting regenerates the bundle and discards your edits.
exportWizard.regenFailed: Could not regenerate the bundle: {reason}. The preview still shows the previous settings — change a setting to try again.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.installRemovesIntro: The same commit also removes the workflow file this feature used before, if the repo still has it:
exportWizard.zipWarning: A zip creates no installation, so DevDigest will not see this repository’s runs — they never appear on CI Runs.
exportWizard.secretNote: One step is left for you: add {key} under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions of {repo}.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.emptyBody: Deploy this agent to run automatically on every pull request in a repo’s CI pipeline.
ciTab.loadError: Could not load this agent’s CI installations.
ciTab.failOnDesc: Exit non-zero when a finding at or above this severity lands. Pair with a required status check to block merges.
ciTab.failOnRepublishNote: A change here reaches CI only after the bundle is republished — the threshold lives in the committed manifest.
ciTab.staleDetail: deployed from v{installed}, current is v{current}
ciTab.unconfirmedNeverPolled: Not checked yet. Refresh on CI Runs to see whether <file>{path}</file> is in this repo.
ciTab.unconfirmedMissing: GitHub Actions has no <file>{path}</file> in this repo, so this agent is not running here. Republish to restore it.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
